decisions.decision: Bundle statesSelect.ts into vendor/states-select.mjs and import it from app.js
decisions.why: It has no imports, and the board already vendors the renderer and styles this way with a CI drift check
decisions.rejected: Moving the file to a shared folder, or copying the function into app.js

decisions.decision: Call setupStatesSelect() once at page load
decisions.why: It listens on the document and the board replaces the panel on every redraw
decisions.rejected: Wiring after each draw, which stacks listeners

decisions.decision: Disable each file name after a draw and turn off its pointer events in CSS
decisions.why: Only disabled removes a button from the tab order
decisions.rejected: Changing the shared renderer to emit a span

decisions.why: Pictures are taken once in release QA

decisions.decision: Set each style attribute again as a property after a document is drawn
decisions.why: The board page policy drops style attributes in markup, which collapsed the states diagram to a heap; setting the property is allowed, so the policy stays strict
The viewer rules carry an id and outrank the board override, so the buttons were in fact showing
decisions.rejected: Matching the viewer selectors one by one

decisions.decision: The changelog entry goes in the root changelog
decisions.why: That is where every Copilot board entry is, tagged area: copilot-app
decisions.rejected: The canvas own changelog, as the task first said

decisions.decision: Review rounds: apply only the states diagram layout properties with numeric values, restore a picked state across a redraw, assert the strike button exists before asserting it is hidden
decisions.why: The first pass showed that re-applying every style attribute would let raw HTML in a plan overlay the page, and that a live run would snap the card back
decisions.rejected: Re-applying all style attributes; matching restored picks by title and name, left as a gap

concerns.note: plan.md call path cites app.js without a line: the import goes at the top of a file that has no imports today
The browser console still logs one policy warning per style attribute when a document is parsed; the styles are then applied as properties, so it is noise, not a fault
No new board screenshot and no check in the real Copilot app; both are left to release QA
Whether a plan run started from the board writes plan blocks was not checked; it needs the real app
A restored pick is matched by card position and state index, so a plan edit that inserts a card above can pick the wrong state
A file name on the board no longer shows its full-path tooltip, because it takes no pointer events
